_doc: Real `rack-protection-4.2.1` vendored 1:1 (base.rb + FrameOptions + XSSHeader + PathTraversal + ReferrerPolicy + IPSpoofing + StrictTransport + ContentSecurityPolicy). Nineteenth diff_framework fixture; second middleware-shaped vendoring (after rack_cors_smoke). Ships no-op `rack.rb`/`rack/utils.rb`/`digest.rb`/`logger.rb`/`uri.rb` stubs because the rubyrs runtime doesn't load real stdlib for those — the three middlewares we vendor don't reach any of the omitted symbols. Tests cover the `X-Frame-Options`/`X-XSS-Protection`/`X-Content-Type-Options` header injection paths AND the PathTraversal cleanup via the `keep_headers` manifest hook + an `/echo_path` route that surfaces the cleaned PATH_INFO. PATH_INFO restoration on the `ensure` block of PathTraversal is also exercised — after the request, the original PATH_INFO is back so downstream middlewares see it unchanged.
name: rack_protection_smoke
